title: bonsai.sessions/1
description: The sessions table, .bonsai/sessions.md (contract §7.5, spec §6): one row per ended session and per ended subagent run (Claude Code only: a subagent runs inside its session and carries its environment), then the hours per task and role. Built from the log's session_start, session_end, subagent_start and subagent_stop records (contract §8); rows are only added, so a row outlives the log file it came from (contract §8.5). It replaces the run report's Sessions table. Times are UTC. Generated: written only by bonsai check --write, in the main checkout, and never by hand (the guard refuses an agent's edit, a tripwire); committed, never changed on a branch (rung 0 refuses one). Read by people (on GitHub and the Desk), agents and the studio. The task files and the log stay the truth: nothing reads a table to decide, and a table grants nothing. A stale table is a check warning everywhere, never a finding (contract §7.5). A markdown file whose frontmatter holds format and whose body holds the rest; a JSON Schema cannot describe a markdown table, so this schema describes what a reader returns (the frontmatter's fields, then what it reads from the body), and the body's lines and column order are formats/README.md's. A writer writes every field below, in this order, null, [] or {} where it does not apply (contract §2.2); a reader treats a missing field as null, keeps an unknown one and refuses a duplicate key.

format.description: The version line, the frontmatter's only key (contract §2.2); it carries a comment saying the file is generated and never edited by hand.

sessions.description: One row per ended session and per ended subagent run, sorted by start, then by session, then by subagent; [] for none.

session.description: The session id's first 8 characters (a subagent run: its session's).

kind.description: session for a session's row, subagent for a subagent run's (Claude Code only), a closed list.

task.description: The row's task, by one rule (contract §7.5): the task named by --task or the environment, if set; else the active task (contract §13) of the checkout or worktree it ran in; else none. As the recorder found it at the start.

role.description: The role: BONSAI_ROLE for a session, the subagent_type for a subagent run; null when none was set.

model.description: The model, as the agent names it; null when the log does not say.

start.description: When it started, UTC, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM as text.

end.description: When it ended, UTC, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM as text.

minutes.description: Whole minutes from start to end.

subagent.description: The subagent run's own id, its first 8 characters (or all of a shorter id); null for a session's row (an empty cell in the table). It tells a subagent run from its session, and keeps two subagent runs of one session apart: a row's key is its session, subagent and start (step 5.2.3). Added in set 6, an addition. A table written before it has no such column, and a reader reads its rows with subagent null.

hours.description: Hours per task and role, with sessions and subagent runs apart: a subagent run lies inside its session's row, so the two are shown apart and never added; sorted by task, role, then kind. [] for none.

task.description: The task, as the rows name it.

role.description: The role, as the rows name it; null for rows with none.

kind.description: session or subagent: which rows are added up, a closed list.

hours.description: The rows' minutes added up, in hours, as the table prints them (one decimal place).
